name: radio-group
behavior: APG radio group pattern (roving tabindex; Arrow keys move selection; Space selects; one tab stop for the group)

parts.note: role=radiogroup; vertical uses space-stack-sm, horizontal uses space-inline-lg per the orientation axis

parts.statesNote: selected border uses action; invalid swaps field-border for status-critical per states.md

parts.note: filled center dot shown only in the selected state

anatomyNotes: Parts are invariant across themes. Salt draws the control as a composed icon (RadioButtonIcon) vs shadcn's bordered circle with inner dot — a RECIPE difference, not different anatomy. Control circle tracks icon-size-control; radius-pill makes it fully round in every theme (including Salt's otherwise square shapes).
